title: Prem
desc: Sanjay is haunted by visions of his past life as Shantanu. His world shifts when he meets Sonia, who resembles a woman from his visions, drawing him into a mysterious fate.

title: Mera Gaon Mera Desh
desc: A reformed man bravely opposes a ruthless village tyrant, but when his beloved is kidnapped, the confrontation turns personal, forcing a fierce battle for justice.

title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
desc: College rivals Lily and Arun fall in love with their parents' support, but their dreams are shattered when she is diagnosed with leukaemia, testing their strength and bond.

title: Saudagar
desc: The friendship between Veeru and Rajeshwar turns into a bitter rivalry over time. Years later, they confront each other again when their grandchildren fall in love.

title: Gully Boy
desc: Murad, an underdog from Dharavi, struggles to express his reality and social issues through rap, until meeting local rapper MC Sher, whose guidance transforms his confidence and dreams.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Crook
desc: Jai, a small-time crook equipped with a new identity, is sent to Australia by his uncle. However, there he gets embroiled in the ongoing racial conflict while also trying to pursue his love interest.

title: Dhaakad
desc: Agent Agni reluctantly accepts a mission to capture Rudraveer, a dangerous trafficker. Her journey takes unexpected turns, pushing her into uncharted paths filled with risk and discovery.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

title: Parichay
desc: Jobless Ravi accepts the daunting task of tutoring five spoiled children who chased away every teacher, but soon wins their trust and falls in love with Rama, the eldest.

title: Singh Is King
desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

title: Mela
desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Prem Rog
desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

title: 420 Ipc
desc: CA Keswani is arrested for bank fraud and forgery. Keswani hires Birbal, a lawyer, to fight his case, but Birbal realises that there's more to it than meets the eye.
